verdict.rationale: stagewise documents running multiple agent instances in parallel, each with its own chat session and model, plus a setting to keep the app awake while agents work, so it covers parallel local agents. Nothing shows fleet-scale orchestration or autonomous runs lasting hours or days. Missing for 10: fleet-scale launching and management, evidence of autonomous runs over hours or days, background or cloud execution beyond the desktop app, independent hands-on corroboration of parallel agents.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: stagewise supports multiple agent instances running in parallel. Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
keep the app awake while agents work
